title: A local resource example
summary: terraform_data is a built-in resource that stores an input in Terraform state. It does not create a cloud machine.
introduction: terraform_data is a built-in resource that stores an input in Terraform state. It does not create a cloud machine. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: terraform_data is a built-in resource that stores an input in Terraform state. It does not create a cloud machine.
The configuration names one local state resource and gives it a greeting. Save it as main.tf in a new practice folder.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Change the greeting text before any plan.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not add provisioner commands to this simple practice resource.
For more detail later, use this [Terraform further reading](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/tutorials).

seo.title: Terraform: A local resource example
